title: BOX OF VARIOUS COLLECTORS CARD...
reason: Catalogued collection of pre-war Australian tobacco cards (Wills, Carreras, Godfrey Phillips, Sniders and Abrahams, Ardath) with a handwritten index, under-described as 'various collectors cards'.
findings: Two photos. Photo 1: a cardboard box plus two yellow tins, a blue plastic tub and a clear plastic box holding a very large number of old trade and cigarette cards, mostly in rubber-banded or string-tied bundles with a handwritten paper label on each (looks like one bundle per set), two small dark red and black card boxes, loose cards in sleeves and a large index sheet lying on the tub. Photo 2 is a clear handwritten index headed 'Australian Issues': Ardath (1935) A72-35 Scenes from Big Films; Carreras (1933-34) C18-92 Football Series (VFL), C18-93 Personality Series, C18-94 Film Stars; Wills W62-212 Animals (cut-outs) full set of 60, W62-221-4 and W62-221-7 Aust. and Eng. Cricketers, W62-218-A Birds of Australasia, W62-267 Crests of Aust. Unis and Schools (1929), W62-282A Footballers (1933), W62-233 Past and Present Champions (1903-1910), W62-247 Victoria Cross Heroes (full set of 25), W62-277A Wild Animal Heads (1934); Sniders and Abrahams S88-13.2 Butterflies and Moths, S88-15 Crests of British Warships (complete set of 64); Godfrey Phillips P50.142 Test Cricketers 1932-33, P50.145 Who's Who in Aust. Sport (1933), P50.143B Victorian Footballers; plus anonymous Belgian Views and The European War (glossy photos). The right-hand columns carry tallies (for example 34, 60, 7, 17, 40, 15, 10, 54). This is an organised, catalogued collection of pre-war Australian tobacco cards, which the title 'various collectors cards' under-describes. The bundle labels are too small to read, so which sets are really in the boxes, and how complete they are, is unverified.
condition: Not assessable from the photos. Cards are in tight rubber-band and string bundles (risk of band marks and edge wear), with some loose cards in sleeves. The index has columns headed E and Q with tallies, but no condition grades are legible.
rescore_note: Large, organised collection of old tobacco and trade cards with a handwritten index of pre-war Australian issues (Wills, Carreras, Godfrey Phillips, Sniders and Abrahams, Ardath; VFL football and Test cricket series; full sets marked for Wills Animals, VC Heroes and Warships); bundle labels unreadable and several sets look part complete, so discounted to the $200-500 band. No comp seen.
